description: Compact, non-interactive labels for status or category information.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: A Tag is a compact, non-interactive label for status or category information. For example, “Paid” lets people scan a payment status at a glance.
whenToUseItems: Show a short status or category next to related content.
Use a clear type and concise label so the meaning is easy to scan.
Use Translucent on colored surfaces only, never on white.
whenNotToUseItems: For filtering or selection, use Chips.

purposes.highlight: Emphasize an important value or offer.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.text: The icon is optional in Default; the text label is required.
rows: 2|Text|Yes|Use a concise status or category label.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.text: Use small when space is limited; use medium as the standard size. Translucent is available only in medium with an icon.
rows: Medium|20px with or without an icon|Use as the standard size.

content.title: Content
content.text: Write a short label that can be understood without reading a sentence.
writingItems: Use one or two words when possible.
Name the status or category directly.
Do not use a Tag as a sentence or as a replacement for supporting content.

doDont.shortDont: Do not put a sentence in a Tag.
doDont.surfaceDo: Place Translucent over a colored surface.
doDont.surfaceDont: Do not place Translucent on white.
doDont.sizesDo: Keep Tags in a row the same size.
doDont.sizesDont: Do not mix sizes in the same row.

behaviors.title: Behaviors
behaviors.text: A Tag is a static label; it does not provide an action or interactive state.
rows: Default|At rest|Uses the selected type and appearance.
Translucent|On a colored surface|Uses a translucent background and contrasting text.
behaviors.longText: The label stays on one line: `.ods-tag__content` uses `white-space: nowrap`. The Tag does not wrap or truncate the text; a long label can extend beyond a narrow container.

badge.title: Badge
badge.text: Use Badge to display a count.

chips.title: Chips
chips.text: Use Chips for filtering or selection.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.text: Found an issue or have a suggestion? [Send feedback](https://github.com/ocean-ds/ocean-web/issues).

color.text: The values below come from the Tag styles. Translucent background tokens are rendered at 24% opacity.

typography.text: Font sizes and weights follow the selected Tag size and variant.
rows: Tag · Highlight|Same as selected size|800|font-weight-extrabold; font-family-base

structure.title: Structure
structure.text: Spacing and radius values follow the Tag component styles.

size.title: Size
size.text: Height is the line box plus vertical padding.

oceanProvides.title: What Ocean provides
oceanProvides.text: Tag is a non-focusable `div` with no explicit role. Its label is read as plain text, and the default icon is marked `aria-hidden`.
keyboardRows: Tab|Tag is not focusable; it is skipped in the keyboard order.

development.title: Development considerations
items: **Use a clear label.** Do not rely on color alone to communicate status.
**Keep the text meaningful.** The label is exposed as plain text to assistive technology.
**Do not add interaction.** If the content performs an action, use an interactive component such as Button.
